# l2-bpmn-scripts

The code that writes a DAK's BPMN, with its tests: `visio-svg-bpmn.ts`, which turns a DAK's Visio business-process figures (SVG) into BPMN with one lane per persona. Scripts that L1 code, an always-on piece or a platform layer also reaches stay in `../../scripts/`, because this subgraph is opt-in.

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `l2-bpmn-scripts`, holding `code`.
